description: You are a senior IT support specialist completing end-of-week housekeeping. Two long-running tickets require closure: (1) Resolve the email account issue (the ticket about not being able to send or receive emails) with this specific resolution: 'Investigated mail server configuration. Found SMTP relay settings were changed during last maintenance window. Reverted SMTP settings to prior configuration: smtp.company.local port 587 with TLS. Confirmed fix by sending test emails from 5 accounts.' Set its status to Resolved. (2) Resolve the Adobe Acrobat Pro installation request with this resolution: 'Adobe Acrobat Pro DC license provisioned via company software portal. Installation completed remotely via SCCM push. User confirmed application is working and PDF editing is accessible.' Set its status to Resolved. (3) After resolving both tickets, close ticket 1002 (the email issue) by setting its status to Closed. (4) Create a new Knowledge Base solution article titled 'Troubleshooting SMTP Email Issues After Maintenance Windows' in the Solutions module, with the content describing the SMTP relay fix as a known workaround. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
